programs.desc: In Operation Torch, the first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops, and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking. In rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

programs.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
programs.desc: If size counts, these machines rewrite all the rules. Dolph Lundgren gets up close inside legendary giants: the Antonov An-225 cargo jet - history's largest aircraft; the 200-ton WWII Maus tank designed by Porsche for Hitler - the largest ever made; and Bigfoot, the original monster truck that created a global phenomenon. When small isn't enough, Dolph goes massive with these supersized beasts.
